condition.label: Corridor-assisted engineering run
condition.plain_language: A same-task engineering run in which Builder constructed a frozen Corridor and both Worker and QA could query it; no matched no-Corridor arm was run.

interpretation.mechanism_summary: Builder produced a frozen task-conditioned Corridor, Worker and QA both queried it, and the final Worker snapshot passed 19/19; incomplete definition closure, unresolved construction readiness, QA not_assessed, and same-task verifier-feedback-informed adaptation prevent complete Method-conformance or causal attribution.
